investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumforge Mobile (mobile operator); Platform: on-premises data center DC-B, server range 10.118.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lumfor-prod (kubeadm); External dependency: fx-svc calls a FX rates API (fx.ratebridge.io) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
